name: Landhaus zum Wilden Kaiser
beschreibung: Landhaus zum Wilden Kaiser welcomes vacationers to a peaceful, sunny setting in Scheffau am Wilden Kaiser in the lower Inn Valley. The residence harmonizes authentic Tyrolean timber architecture with modern holiday living. Bright and comfortable guest rooms and self-catering apartments feature private balconies with breathtaking, uninterrupted views of the rugged Wilder Kaiser cliffs. A spacious garden lawn provides a restful oasis after mountain adventures. In summer, scenic paths lead toward the KaiserWelt theme park and crystal-clear Lake Hintersteiner See, while the winter ski shuttle connects swiftly to the vast SkiWelt slopes.
kurzbeschreibung: Charming alpine lodge in Scheffau am Wilden Kaiser with dramatic Kaisergebirge views and comfort.
